title: 전원위원회 운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Meetings of the Committee of the Whole)
(1) The Committee of the Whole shall meet after a report on the examination of the relevant agenda item or an explanation of the proposal has been made at the plenary session.
(2) The Committee of the Whole shall hold its first meeting on the day on which the report on examination or explanation of the proposal referred to in paragraph (1) is made: Provided, That where unavoidable circumstances prevent a meeting from being held on that day, the Chairperson of the Committee of the Whole may, in consultation with the secretaries, hold the first meeting on the following day.
